definitions.explanation: The middle ten days of a month, roughly the 11th through 20th. One of the three standard divisions of a month in Japanese.

examples.japanese: 3⟦{月|がつ}→月：30418_gatsu⟧{中旬|ちゅうじゅん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{届|とど}く→届く：00899_todoku⟧⟦{予定|よてい}→予定：00824_yotei⟧です。
examples.english: It's expected to arrive in mid-March.

examples.japanese: ⟦{桜|さくら}→桜：02212_sakura⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧4⟦{月|がつ}→月：30418_gatsu⟧{中旬|ちゅうじゅん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{満開|まんかい}→満開：13319_mankai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: The cherry blossoms reach full bloom around mid-April.

examples.japanese: ⟦{来月|らいげつ}→来月：00744_raigetsu⟧{中旬|ちゅうじゅん}⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{報告書|ほうこくしょ}→報告書：06744_houkokusho⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{提出|ていしゅつ}して→提出する：19644_teishutsusuru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please submit the report by the middle of next month.

notes:
Japanese divides each month into three ten-day periods:

- ⟦{上旬|じょうじゅん}→上旬：17767_joujun⟧ (first ten days, roughly 1st-10th)
- {中旬|ちゅうじゅん} (middle ten days, roughly 11th-20th)
- ⟦{下旬|げじゅん}→下旬：00062_gejun⟧ (last ten days, roughly 21st-end)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ～⟦{月|がつ}→月：30418_gatsu⟧{中旬|ちゅうじゅん} (mid-[month])
- {中旬|ちゅうじゅん}ごろ (around mid-month)
- {中旬|ちゅうじゅん}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{下旬|げじゅん}→下旬：00062_gejun⟧⟦にかけて→〜にかけて：30530_nikakete⟧ (from mid to late month)

This system is commonly used in weather forecasts, delivery estimates, event planning, and seasonal descriptions.
